jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. Amazon Connect Customer is an innovative cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. With Amazon Connect Customer you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free easy-to-use extensible and natural customer experience. With this technology we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them. Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch Amazon Connect Customer has become an AI leader transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers. Customer Engagement Experiences is a part of the Amazon Connect Customer Agentic Customer Experiences organization building industry leading agentic applications and experiences that enable our customers to deeply engage their own customers at a scale and depth never before possible. We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems while designing beautiful simple user experiences. We are looking for a passionate talented and experienced Technical Program Manager to join Amazon Connect's Customer Engagement Experiences team responsible for the capabilities that help companies deliver agentic experiences at scale across all personas. You will play a crucial role in developing the next generation of generative AI infused agent manager and end-customer experience capabilities and have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus. As a Technical Program Manager on our team you will drive strategic initiatives from conception through completion. You will work cross-functionally across teams to solve challenging problems using the latest technologies. You will make data-driven customer-obsessed decisions and work with leadership across AWS to prioritize your programs. The position is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing business and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will play a crucial role in developing the next generation of AWS application services and have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus. You will be a technical lead on our cross-functional projects. You will ensure quality of architecture and design of systems. Functionally decompose complex problems into simple straight-forward solutions. Align project deliverables with target Quality and functionality and on time release. You are a person that has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality technology products/services in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift fast. You exert technical influence on the core platform teams external dev teams and partners increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your knowledge and experience. In this role you will be part of a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning. You will build software that will materially improve people's lives. Key job responsibilities • Connect Customer Engagement Experiences is dedicated to ensuring that Amazon Connect Customer the innovative cloud-based contact center used by millions of support agents every day is able to deliver industry-leading agentic applications and experiences that enable our customers to deeply engage their own customers at a scale and depth never before possible. As the Principal TPM for Amazon Customer Engagement Experiences you'll help shape the technical product and execution vision for one of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses. • In this role you'll... • Work across a diverse set of stakeholder organizations to prioritize and manage large development projects • Partner with external companies to bring Connect Customer integrations onto their desktops • Connect the dots across many sub-teams to ensure consistent execution • Track and report data and manage organizational mechanisms to help stakeholders understand the business • Report on team status across several executive communication channels About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Job Description:

Carelon Lead Generation Specialist / Sales Development Representative

Location: This role requires associates to be in-office 1-2 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office.

The Carelon Lead Generation Specialist / Sales Development Representative is responsible for finding, connecting with, and qualifying high-potential prospects. This person will transform raw inquiries and targeted outbound lists into high-value opportunities for the sales team.

How you will make an impact:

• Identifies, engages, and cultivates relationships with potential clients and current customers. Deploys efficient processes and metrics.
• Drives initiatives to create and nurture high-quality leads.
• Reaches out to prospects via email, phone, and social media to initiate contact and set up discovery meetings.
• Performs market research to identify new growth opportunities and target segments for lead generation.
• Analyzes lead generation efforts and communicates results.
• Produces regular reports on lead generation performance, insights, and recommendations for senior management.
• Works with cross-functional internal partners to achieve business objectives and on new solutions, product launches, and unique selling propositions.
• Uses core technology stack supporting lead generation, including lead generation products and relevant platforms.
• Establishes and optimizes end-to-end lead generation processes to ensure seamless operations and high conversion rates.
• Ensures all lead generation activities adhere to relevant regulations and best practices.
• Success in this role is measured through a mix of consistent activity, high-quality conversations, and real pipeline impact, including: Outbound activity (dials + touches) ,Connections , Response time , Meetings set & held ,Pipeline generated / influenced ,Conversion rates , Data hygiene & process adherence.

Minimum Requirements:

Requires a BA/BS in marketing, business administration, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or any combination of education and experience which would provide an equivalent background.

• MA/MS preferred.

• Prior BDR/SDR or Customer Experience/Service engaging with Enterprise-sized prospects; health plan experience preferred.
• Experience in resilient and positive mindset preferred.

jobs.description: Location: 1 N Wacker Drive, Chicago Illinois Job Summary The Corporate Access Planner is responsible for originating, planning, marketing, executing, and following up on corporate access activity across NDRs, conferences, field trips, analyst marketing, group meetings, and related events. The role connects corporate management teams, investor relations professionals, research analysts, institutional investors, and sales partners while delivering high-quality execution, clear communication, accurate data, and a strong client experience. Key Responsibilities Include: · Event origination and execution: Plan and execute NDRs, conferences, bus tours, field trips, analyst marketing trips, virtual meetings, and one-on-one schedules from initial idea through post-event follow-up; manage schedules, logistics, travel, venues, materials, registration, day-of changes, and issue resolution. · Analyst and corporate coverage: Own day-to-day planning for assigned analysts, covered companies, and sectors; develop access opportunities around earnings, conferences, initiations, thematic work, investor demand, and franchise priorities. · Issuer and investor communication: Serve as a trusted execution contact for IR officers, management teams, investors, analysts, sales, and internal leaders; communicate confirmations, agendas, itineraries, changes, and feedback clearly and professionally. · Marketing and demand generation: Create and distribute invitations, announcements, itineraries, agendas, and related materials; partner with sales to identify priority investors, track interest, fill schedules, and drive participation from targeted accounts. · Data, reporting, and systems: Maintain accurate event, attendance, request, cancellation, and corporate data in iPlanner and other systems; support resource-consumption reporting, broker vote preparation, account reviews, client strategy, and resource-allocation decisions. · Controls and process discipline: Follow applicable research independence, information-barrier, MNPI, gifts and entertainment, expense, and other KeyBank policies; manage costs responsibly and recommend workflow improvements that improve quality, scale, consistency, and stakeholder experience. Qualifications and Skills Include: · Experience in corporate access, investor relations, event coordination, research, institutional equity sales support, marketing, business development, or a comparable client-service role. · Working knowledge of institutional equities, research, banking, sales, and corporate access, with the ability to manage multiple priorities on tight timelines. · Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort with senior management teams, IR officers, institutional investors, and internal leaders. · Advanced organization, project management, prioritization, follow-through, and attention to detail; analytical mindset paired with a sales-oriented approach. · Proficiency in Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Copilot, CRM/reporting tools, and event-management platforms; experience with iPlanner, MeetMax, BDVisions, Datazoic, Salesforce, and Concur preferred. · Willingness to travel periodically Personal Skills and Core Competencies · Persuasion, sound judgment, ownership, composure, collaboration, adaptability, client service, inclusive partnership, and continuous improvement. · Ability to anticipate needs, resolve issues under pressure, protect confidential information, and maintain accountability for outcomes. Measures of Success · Events are executed cleanly, professionally, and without visible logistics failures for clients, corporate management teams, or internal partners. · Analysts, IR contacts, bankers, and sales partners view the Planner as a trusted and responsive partner. · Priority accounts are consistently targeted, schedules are filled efficiently, and relevant investor demand is captured and communicated. · Event data, attendance, reporting, and dashboards are accurate, timely, and useful for broker votes, account reviews, and resource decisions. Education Qualification s Bachelor's Degree or equivalent Experience Qualifications Proven experience driving marketing efforts to fuel new business opportunities and/or strengthening existing partnerships. (required) Client service mindset – able to anticipate the needs of both internal and external constituents. (required) Deep understanding of how to create/curate investor prep sheets and marketing invitations, with oftentimes imperfect data. (required) Candidate must have an analytical mind set paired with a sales disposition. (required) Should be driven, detail oriented, strong ability to multitask, as well as possess the ability to work well under pressure. (required) Tactical Skills Strong presentation and platform skills Ability to appreciate, understand and work effectively with diverse population. Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint Skills. Excellent customer service, communication, and writing skills Personal Skills Persuasion: Describes the importance of listening to communicate for impact and selects most appropriate communication approach depending on message and audience Decision Making: The ability to select the right activities to work on from a range of competing priorities and stands by decisions in the face of conflict or unexpected outcomes Collaboration: Demonstrates experience in participating in productive collaborative processes that help solve business problems and meet business goals Core Competencies All KeyBank employees are expected to demonstrate Key’s Values and sustain proficiency in identified Leadership Competencies. 회사 소개
쿠팡플레이는 쿠팡 와우회원에게 제공되는 스트리밍 서비스입니다. 오리지널 콘텐츠, TV 시리즈, 최신 영화, 스포츠, 키즈 & 패밀리, 뉴스 등 대한민국에서 가장 포괄적인 콘텐츠 라인업을 자랑합니다. 또한 <쿠팡플레이 시리즈>를 비롯한 다양한 스포츠 이벤트와 최정상 아티스트들의 콘서트 등, 차별화된 오프라인 이벤트를 기획·운영하며, 끊임없이 새로운 화제를 만들어가고 있습니다.
쿠팡플레이는 언제 어디서나 최적의 시청 경험을 제공합니다. 대한민국에서 공식 판매되는 모든 모바일 기기, 태블릿, 스마트 TV, PC, 애플 TV, 안드로이드 TV 등 다양한 디바이스에서 이용할 수 있습니다. 서울, 싱가포르, 미국 캘리포니아 등에 분포된 글로벌 테크 전담 조직은 고객이 콘텐츠를 더 쉽게 발견하고 더 쾌적하게 시청할 수 있도록 지속적으로 경험을 개선해 가고 있습니다.
세계 최고의 동료들과 함께 가장 도전적인 문제를 해결하며 새로운 가치를 만들어 가고 싶은 분, 젊고 발 빠르게 움직이는 조직에서 자신의 역량을 급격하게 성장시키고자 하는 분들의 많은 지원을 바랍니다.
직무 소개
Senior Product Manager는 쿠팡플레이 Play Operations 도메인의 전략과 제품 비전을 수립하고, 콘텐츠 운영을 위한 핵심 플랫폼 및 시스템의 혁신을 주도합니다. 본 포지션은 콘텐츠 온보딩부터 서비스 종료까지 콘텐츠 라이프사이클 전반을 지원하는 Content Management System(CMS) 및 운영 도구를 담당하며, 확장 가능한 플랫폼 구축을 통해 비즈니스 성장을 지원합니다. 또한 엔지니어링, 콘텐츠 운영, 마케팅, 비즈니스 조직 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하여 운영 효율성을 높이고 고객 경험 개선에 기여합니다. 데이터 기반 의사결정과 기술적 이해를 바탕으로 복잡한 문제를 해결하고 새로운 성장 기회를 발굴할 수 있는 Product Leader를 찾고 있습니다.
업무 내용
쿠팡플레이 Play Operations 도메인 및 Content Management System의 제품 비전, 전략, 목표 및 로드맵 수립
콘텐츠 온보딩부터 서비스 종료까지 전 라이프사이클을 지원하는 확장 가능한 플랫폼 및 운영 프로세스 구축
인공지능(AI) 및 자동화 기술을 활용한 콘텐츠 온보딩, 메타데이터 관리 및 운영 워크플로우 고도화
프로덕트, 엔지니어링, 콘텐츠 운영 및 마케팅 조직과의 협업을 통한 제품 전략 수립, 우선순위 관리 및 실행 주도

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

Return to Work Program – Sandy

At Morgan Stanley, we recognize the immense potential in experienced professionals who have taken a career break and are now eager to return to the workforce. We value the life skills and experiences you've gained outside of work and recognize the significant contributions you can bring to our organization.

You don’t have to have a background in financial services to have a career with us. We welcome highly motivated candidates from a diverse range of industries and skills. We strive to create a spirit of inclusion by bringing together dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds, talents, perspectives, cultural identities, and experiences.

Our Sandy Return to Work program will run from January 18, 2027 through May 7, 2027 in our Sandy office. This 16-week paid program places participants in roles that align with their existing expertise while also broadening their horizons through comprehensive training, mentorship, and professional development.

Financial Service Representative — Return to Work Candidates

In the Wealth Management division, we help people, businesses and institutions build, preserve, and manage wealth so they can pursue their financial goals.

Are you interested in financial services? Have you always wanted to learn the inner workings of the stock market? Do you get excited about solving problems and having customers compliment your work? Are you goal-driven and competitive? If you answered yes to these questions, you’re the person we want on our Financial Services team!

As an unlicensed Financial Services Representative, you would use your amazing customer service skills and knack for problem-solving to engage our clients via incoming calls and answer various questions related to their stock portfolios.

To get you started in your career with us, Morgan Stanley will pay for your training to obtain your Series 7 & 63 Licenses.

In This Role You Will:

•

Provide excellent customer service by identifying customer needs and determining the best solution for them.

•

Educate customers on Morgan Stanley’s competitive advantage and identify additional products they would benefit from.

•

Show us your determination to drive sales by engaging customers and identifying new opportunities.

•

Follow processes and manage your time efficiently throughout the day.

•

Continually learn about investments and the financial markets to address the individual client's investment needs.

•

Help the company identify opportunities to keep our clients and do your part to minimize risk, when necessary.

•

Be required to maintain a high level of personal integrity and comply with Morgan Stanley’s Code of Conduct. You’ll have to sign a statement agreeing to this; it’s important.

•

Connect with other groups to gather info to resolve customer issues (you will never be on your own, we’re a family).

•

Be involved in other projects and tasks (because there may be other things you can help with).

A Typical Workday as a Financial Services Representative includes:

•

Fielding inbound customer inquiries to assist customers with account related requests such as money movement, account updates, and trade requests.

•

Following up with customers regarding outstanding account related items.

•

Participating in continuing education and development.

Benefits of being a Morgan Stanley Financial Services Representative:

•

Develop a robust understanding of the financial services industry and gain insight into one of the world’s leading financial institutions.

•

Invest in your career with a top tier learning and career development experience combining comprehensive financial product modules and learning courses, as well as on the job learning.

•

Obtain the Series 7 & 63 licenses that will be paid for by Morgan Stanley.

•

Enjoy a hybrid work environment that enables employees to thrive.

•

Competitive base salary and a wide range of additional benefits including:

•

Paid time off

•

Savings programs

•

Health care (medical, dental, vision)

•

Insurance plans

•

Tuition and licensing reimbursement along with student loan refinancing

•

Fitness subsidy

•

401(k) with competitive firm matching, as well as access to the Morgan Stanley Employee Stock Purchase Program

•

Family building benefit to assist employees with the cost of adoption, surrogacy, and fertility treatments

•

Generous parental leave

•

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

•

Employees are encouraged to give back to your community

What You Bring to the Table:

•

A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Management or Administration, or have an equivalent combination of education, training and experience (1 year of work experience can substitute 1 year of education)

•

You’ve spent at least 2 years working in a customer-facing role

•

MUST be flexible to work a hybrid schedule (3 days a week in office)

•

To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

Even better if you:

•

Have at least 2 years’ experience working in a call center environment or within a financial institution

•

You can articulate your experience working on a team and in a highly collaborative environment

•

You have previously been in a role where you had to meet sales goals either through full time work or college internships

•

You’re considered a people-person and have extraordinary interpersonal skills, a strong team orientation and resiliency

Program Duration: Return to Work programs will run for approximately 16 weeks from January 18, 2027 to May 7, 2027.

Eligibility Criteria: This program is designed for individuals who have been out of the workforce for two or more years. The two-year eligibility requirement will be calculated as of the January 2027 program start date.

We invite you to apply and take the first step towards a rewarding and fulfilling professional journey. Applications open September 15 and close October 9, 2026. To learn more about the program, please visit: www.morganstanley.com/returntowork.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

jobs.description: Fauna Robotics is building the future of personal robotics — and we want it to be the best platform for researchers and developers to build on. We’re looking for a leader to build and scale our academic segment: the programs, partnerships, and mechanisms that put Fauna robots into the hands of the world’s top robotics researchers and turn them into a thriving, self-reinforcing community. You'll own the strategy, the relationships, and the sales channel end-to-end — from a researcher's first pilot to institution-wide adoption. You will own how labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets. You'll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers' hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You'll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform. You will be Fauna’s primary point of engagement with the robotics research community. You’ll own the strategy and the relationships end-to-end — from qualifying a priority lab to scaling adoption across an entire institution. You’ll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers’ hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You’ll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform. And you’ll own the sales channel for the segment — the paths by which labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets. Just as importantly, you’ll be the bridge between that community and our product org — translating what researchers discover into a clearer roadmap, better robots, and a stronger talent pipeline. This is a role for someone who works shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists and AI researchers, knows the rhythms of academic life, and wants to build the definitive research robotics platform with them. This role owns the research/academic segment end-to-end as its relationship, program, sales, and customer-success lead. You’ll work hand-in-hand with partner functions — product, fleet operations & logistics, data/telemetry engineering, and our broader ecosystem team — who own the shared infrastructure, so you can stay focused on strategy, relationships, and impact. Key job responsibilities Segment Strategy & Sales - Own the strategy for Fauna’s academic segment: map and prioritize target institutions and labs, define what makes Fauna the platform of choice for researchers, and set the adoption plan. - Manage our pipeline of funded labs, principal investigators, and technical champions — qualifying opportunities on research value, funding path, influence, and expansion potential. - Own the sales channel for the research segment — the paths by which labs and institutions acquire, deploy, and grow their Fauna fleets, always grounded in research fit. - Partner with fleet operations, finance, and legal to structure the grant, sponsored-research, pricing, and purchase options that fit how universities actually buy. - Build repeatable paths and clean handoffs from an individual researcher to lab- and institution-wide adoption. - Serve as the connection between Amazon-internal research and academic teams and Fauna product/engineering, coordinating with Amazon Robotics and Amazon Science on shared interests. University Partnerships & Grants - Own the university grant program end-to-end: application, evaluation, awarding, and reporting. - Design and operate the access mechanisms that get robots into researchers’ hands — grant, phased-access, and fellows-style programs, including eligibility, selection, onboarding, and program goals. - Run pilots end-to-end; remove trust, funding, and technical blockers; drive real activation, retention, and expansion. - Partner with Fauna Science and Scholars on program design and relationships with target universities. - Support the Fauna intern program, linking academic partnerships to the talent pipeline. External Engagement & Community - Represent Fauna at key conferences (ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI) — sponsorships, workshops, talks, and demos. - Convene and manage a Research Advisory Board to guide program design and the hardware/software roadmaps. - Amplify state-of-the-art partner research and results on Fauna robots, in partnership with our marketing team. Research Experience & Product Feedback - Own the researcher relationship and experience for the university/research fleet — onboarding, enablement, and satisfaction. - Partner with product and leadership to define what we want out of research: which capabilities it pressure-tests, what feedback should shape the hardware and software roadmaps, and how it strengthens Fauna. - Translate community requirements into prioritized input for product and engineering. - Turn early usage into product feedback, case studies, peer proof, and repeatable enablement. - Partner with fleet operations and data/telemetry teams to keep researchers productive and their robots healthy. Metrics & Reporting - Define the program’s KPIs — robots deployed and utilization, researcher activation / retention / expansion, researcher NPS, publications on Fauna robots, community engagement, and grant pipeline health — and use them to inform strategy and leadership reviews. About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build. If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose.

Position Overview

Multifamily Capital Markets is seeking an exceptionally curious, analytical, and driven professional to help identify, prioritize, and deliver the initiatives that can most improve the business. This is a rare opportunity to develop a broad view across the Multifamily Capital Markets organization, including loan pricing, pipeline risk management, portfolio management, securitization, credit-risk transfer, operations, and technology.

You will work directly with a Capital Markets leader who brings deep Multifamily expertise, extensive Wall Street markets and product experience, and a track record of developing innovative solutions to complex financial problems.

Together, you will examine how the business operates, identify its highest-impact opportunities, challenge existing assumptions, and develop solutions from first principles.

This is a hands-on role combining original problem-solving, quantitative analysis, and end-to-end initiative delivery. You will research unfamiliar topics; analyze financial, market, and operational data; build analytical models and lightweight Python prototypes; test hypotheses; frame business questions; and develop fact-based recommendations. You will write the memos and presentations that move decisions forward, document conclusions and requirements, coordinate contributors, maintain project plans and follow-ups, and drive multiple initiatives through organizational and technical roadblocks from initial idea through implementation.

The successful candidate will be expected to operate with substantial independence and combine analytical depth with exceptional conscientiousness and execution discipline. The role requires someone who takes ownership, maintains momentum across multiple complex initiatives, pursues unresolved issues, and keeps driving until decisions are made and outcomes are delivered.

Our Impact

Multifamily Capital Markets sits at the intersection of markets, products, risk, capital, and the economics of the Multifamily business. The department prices loans, manages pipeline and portfolio exposures, accesses the capital markets through securitization and credit-risk transfer, and manages retained investments.

The Strategy and Priorities function takes a department-wide view. We identify the questions and opportunities with the greatest potential impact, develop a clear view of the economics and trade-offs, and work across functions to help turn the best ideas into durable business improvements.

This role will help department leadership:

•

Help identify the opportunities and problems with the greatest potential impact on the business.

•

Create an integrated view across products, risks, economics, and Capital Markets functions.

•

Improve transparency into business performance, risk, and management trade-offs.

•

Move promising ideas from concept through implementation.

•

Ensure important initiatives have clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through.

Your Impact

In this role, you will:

•

Help leadership prioritize initiatives based on business value, urgency, complexity, and resource requirements.

•

Turn broad ideas and unresolved business issues into defined objectives, analyses, workstreams, and decisions.

•

Examine problems from first principles, test assumptions, and develop fact-based recommendations.

•

Coordinate work across Capital Markets teams and partners in Finance, Risk, Operations, Technology, and other parts of the company.

•

Establish owners, milestones, dependencies, and decision points; anticipate roadblocks; pursue open items; and keep initiatives moving toward resolution.

•

Gather and reconcile information, analyze financial, market, and operational data, build quantitative models, and identify gaps or conflicting conclusions.

•

Write concise, decision-ready memos and presentations that explain the issue, analysis, alternatives, economics, recommendation, and required actions.

•

Translate agreed-upon approaches into clear business requirements and implementation plans.

•

Remain engaged through delivery while ensuring that the appropriate business or operating function owns the resulting capability.

•

Develop analyses and Python prototypes when useful to test an idea, demonstrate an approach, or clarify business and technical requirements.

The candidate will be expected to frame issues independently, work directly with senior leaders and subject-matter experts, resolve cross-functional obstacles, and maintain ownership and momentum across multiple complex initiatives with limited direction.

Qualifications

•

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

•

8 - 10 years of experience in capital markets, financial services, portfolio management, securitization, quantitative analysis, business analysis, product development, or initiative delivery.

•

Familiarity with fixed income, mortgages, derivatives, hedging, credit-risk transfer, or asset-liability management.

•

Demonstrated ability to analyze data and working proficiency with Python, SQL, Excel, or other analytical tools.

•

Demonstrated conscientiousness, ownership, and follow-through while managing several concurrent projects.

•

Understanding of P&L, financial analysis, market-risk measurement, capital allocation, or financial reporting.

•

Experience converting business needs into implementation requirements.

•

Advanced degree in finance, economics, quantitative finance, business, engineering, or a related field, preferred

Keys to Success in This Role

•

Curious: Wants to understand how the business actually works and does not stop at the first explanation.

•

A first-principles thinker: Separates fundamental objectives and economics from inherited processes and assumptions.

•

A driver: Creates and sustains momentum without waiting for detailed instructions.

•

An integrator: Brings together the right people, analysis, and decisions across Capital Markets functions.

Structured: Converts broad ideas into clear questions, deliverables, sequencing, and ownership.

Conscientious and relentless: Produces accurate, complete work; closes loops; anticipates roadblocks; and persistently finds a path forward when projects stall.

An owner: Treats initiatives as personal commitments from the initial question through the delivered outcome.
